He looks directly at the lens with a neutral expression while text overlays appear at the top of the frame. (2) As the music starts, he begins a rhythmic dance, swaying his body and using his hands to gesture toward the camera. Pedestrians in the background street scene walk past neon signs and brightly lit storefronts. (3) He transitions through various energetic dance styles, including shoulder shrugs and hand-clapping, synchronized with shifting text overlays that name classic pop songs. His facial expressions become increasingly animated and joyful as he performs. (4) In the final phase, he executes high-energy movements before breaking into a laugh, looking slightly off-camera. He then walks out of the frame to the right, leaving the static city background visible for a split second.
